matches.rationale: The finding directly identifies the contradictory treatment of r as a function of t in the Leibniz rule application during the MeanFlow identity derivation (Eq. 6), matching the same locus and mechanism as the ground truth defect.
No finding addresses the incorrect substitution of v_t = a't x + b't ε with a t x + b t ε or the omission of time derivatives in the conditional velocity formula.
No finding discusses the unjustified exact substitution of marginal velocity v(z_t,t) by conditional velocity v_t or the bias this introduces.
